The port's MIT license does not cover these assets or imply redistribution

their respective copyright notices. Licensed under the Academic Free License
version 2.0; a copy is included in AFL-2.0.txt.
Source: https://github.com/ps2dev/ps2sdk
Includes the pad, audio, kernel and supporting runtime libraries, and the
embedded freesio2, freepad and audsrv IOP modules from PS2SDK.

gsKit / dmaKit: Copyright 2004 - Chris "Neovanglist" Gilbert and contributors.
Licensed under the Academic Free License version 2.0.
Source: https://github.com/ps2dev/gsKit

The PS2 port links these libraries without modifying their source.
The source repositories above retain the original attribution notices.
Compiler runtime: GCC libgcc, GPLv3 with the GCC Runtime Library Exception.
Source and exception: https://gcc.gnu.org/git.html
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gcc-exception-3.1.html
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

Offline tools (not console runtime): UnityPy, NumPy, Pillow, SoundFile and
pycdlib. These are installed separately and are not embedded Python packages.
See tools/requirements.txt and tools/requirements-release.txt.
